about: What djwasm 0.2.0 renders on the ABI-1 call sequence. Every later module must reproduce these hashes (scripts/djrust-golden.mjs check). Made once from the pinned module; never regenerate it to make a check pass.

format.audio: sha256 of interleaved little-endian f32 L,R per frame over every frame rendered
format.ticks: sha256 of the int32 LE return of every process() call
format.report: sha256 of the raw djw_report() out bytes + "\n", per block that ticked
format.marking: sha256 of the raw djw_marking() out bytes + "\n", per block that ticked
format.muted: sha256 of the raw djw_muted() out bytes + "\n", per block that ticked
format.project: sha256 of the project JSON text passed to load() (corpus lowering, not engine output)

callSequence: newInstance; init(sr); load(json); setMute(id,true) per lowered mute; setTempo(override) if any; play(); then per 128-frame quantum q: apply script messages with step.q <= q (worklet apply() semantics), process(128)

blockSize.verdict: block-size independent on every measured case: 128, 37 and 4096 give one sha

readsNeutral.note: djw_report/djw_marking/djw_muted on every ticked block vs never: audio sha

triRender.how: make test-djrust-browser (headless google-chrome, CDP): Node direct (loader.js), Node worklet (worklet.js, TextEncoder/TextDecoder deleted), Chrome OfflineAudioContext (suspend at q + sentinel ack), live AudioContext through scripts/fixtures/capture-worklet.js (suspend near q, schedule read from the tap)
triRender.renderQuantum: 128 on every quantum of every offline and live render
triRender.result: all four renderers equal on all 4 scripts; offline on the nominal schedule equals the golden script hash
triRender.note: The 0.2.0 worklet cannot apply a message on a chosen quantum in a live context, so the live run fixes the schedule and the other three replay it. 0.3.0 adds processorOptions.script (frame-stamped) for that.

loadMemory.finding: djwasm 0.2.0 grows linear memory on every djw_load and never reuses it: about 9 MB per load of the 591 kB techno:42:standard document, about 1.4 MB per load of a 31 kB loop, even with no process() between loads. Mute/tempo churn does not grow memory. Not an audio difference; scripts/djrust-cpu.mjs gates later modules to no more bytes per load than the pin.
